features.name: Harness & toolchain bootstrap

features.name: P0 remainder: /config createKit + example plugin

features.name: /messaging
features.description: defineMessages 轻量工厂（ns 前缀类型 + 守卫；畸形消息静默丢弃）+ kitMessages 框架内置协议。源：ready-svg handoff.ts 内 7 消息形提炼（溯源表 §9）

features.name: /io
features.description: clipboard（原样）/ asset-io 核（产品 fetcher 注入化）/ flag-store（onboarding 泛化 createFlagStore(ns)）/ 存储封装。源：ready-svg lib/clipboard·asset-io·onboarding

features.name: /session
features.description: session-codec / auth-rest / session-store（近原样，已 DI）+ me-cache 泛型化（最小身份契约 { userId }，键 ns 化）。Supabase 特定保留。源：ready-svg lib/session-*·me-cache

features.name: /api
features.description: apiFetch 传输骨架（Bearer/401 映射/信封守卫/multipart/raw 双通道）——MeInfo 完全归产品，/api 纯传输。源：ready-svg lib/api-client.ts 传输核

features.name: /panel
features.description: panel-host / panel-prefs（键/消息/DOM id ns 化；panel.html 地址/宽度/边线样式可配）。源：ready-svg lib/panel-host·panel-prefs

features.name: /react (useSession)

features.name: /content
features.description: 目标无关运行时（徽标三态机/悬停隐现/顶层重挂 + storage.session 交接通道 + 扫描机制）+ capture source 接口（discover/eligibility/extract/decodeCdn 可选）+ 图片抓取源（page-image 泛化）+ cdn 代理取字节层。源：ready-svg lib/badge-overlay·page-image·handoff + content 入口扫描机制
